chunks: And We made them leaders to guide (the people) by Our command; and We inspired them to perform good deeds and observe their moral obligations and pay the zakat; and they obeyed Us.
ai.seo_question: What are the key qualities and roles of the Prophets as described in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the concept of Imamah, affirming that the Prophets and Imams possess divinely appointed authority (Amr) to guide the community. It underscores their dual role as both spiritual exemplars who receive divine inspiration (Wahy) for righteous action and as institutional leaders who establish the pillars of worship, thereby linking theological leadership with practical religious observance.
